issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'Joash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel' (יוֹאָשׁ בֶּן יְהוֹאָחָז מֶלֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵל), but the Chinese renders it as '以色列王約雅敬的兒子約阿施' (Joash son of Jehoiakim king of Israel). The name 'Jehoahaz' (יְהוֹאָחָז) has been replaced with 'Jehoiakim' (約雅敬), which is a different person and changes the identity of the Israelite king's father.
